name: Written in the Sky
source:
After stalking a suspicious figure through the night, Azure stumbles across an odd, black box, bearing alien writing. And within that box she finds a small ring, just her size, with writing matching that of the box. Without thinking, Azure picks up the ring, and the moment she does, footsteps appear behind her.

This ring changes her future drastically making each day action packed.

[Excerpts from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/416130/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Azure整夜跟踪一个可疑身影后，偶然发现一只写有外星文字的黑色盒子。盒子里面有一枚小戒指，大小正好适合她，戒指上的文字也与盒子相同。Azure不假思索地拿起戒指，就在那一刻，身后传来了脚步声。

这枚戒指彻底改变了她的未来，让她的每一天都充满惊险。

[节选自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/416130/]Steam[/url]]
